'''Sue-Jane Wang''' is a [[biostatistics|biostatistician]] at the United States [[Food and Drug Administration]] (FDA), where she works as the Biostatistics Lead and as the liaison from the Office of Biostatistics to the FDA [[Center for Drug Evaluation and Research]] (CDER) Biomarker Qualification Program. She is also deputy division director for biometrics in the Office of Biostatistics.{{r|metabesity}}<ref>{{Cite web |last=Research |first=Center for Drug Evaluation and |date=2024-06-05 |title=Office of Biostatistics |url=https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/cder-offices-and-divisions/office-biostatistics |access-date=2024-07-26 |website=FDA |language=en}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Wang earned a master's degree in statistics from the [[University of Missouri]] in 1984, a second master's degree in biostatistics from the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] in 1986, and a Ph.D. in biostatistics from the [[University of Southern California]] in 1993.{{r|cv}}

She has been a senior expert statistician at the FDA since 2004, and a former distinguished faculty member in CDER. For many years she was associate director for Adaptive Design and Pharmacogenomics.{{r|metabesity}}

She was editor-in-chief of the ''Journal of Pharmaceutical Statistics'' from 2006 to 2008, and of the ''International Chinese Statistics Association Bulletin'' from 2000 to 2002.{{r|cv}}

==Recognition==
In 2011, Wang was elected to be a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].{{r|jhu|cv}} She is also an Elected Member of the [[International Statistical Institute]].{{r|cv}}
